## Smarter Project Documents
### From RFPs and [BEPs](https://plannerly.com/plan/) to Briefs and Meeting Minutes – create, organize, and sign off – in one smart, sharable space.
![BIM Execution Plan \(BEP\)](https://plannerly.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/BIM-Execution-Planning-BEP-1.png)
Say goodbye to time-consuming unstructured documents!
**[Harness the power of AI](https://plannerly.com/bim-ai-tools/)** and drag-and-drop templates to quickly create your **[Building Information Modeling](https://plannerly.com/building-information-modeling-bim/)** standards, processes & legal agreements.
Free templates include OIR, EIR, PIR, AIR, BEP & more, following **[ISO 19650](https://plannerly.com/what-is-iso-19650/)** BIM Standards …and build your own!
Easily manage all your project documents in one place & rest easy knowing you’re always in compliance with your standards!
[Learn More](https://plannerly.com/demo)
## Simple Visual Scoping
### Bring clarity to every deliverable, task, and information requirement – from LOD to LOIN and ISO 19650.
With **[Scope](https://plannerly.com/scope/)** , you can set the standards like a pro!
Our sleek, intuitive interface follows all industry-standard frameworks such as**[AIA](https://www.aia.org/), [BIM Forum](https://bimforum.org/)**, and **[ISO 19650](https://plannerly.com/what-is-iso-19650/), [Level of Information Need](https://plannerly.com/scope)** to ensure everyone’s on the same page.
No more miscommunication or last-minute surprises. Stay on track with a crystal-clear vision every step of the way.
Give Scope a try and experience the power of intuitive project management
[Learn More](https://plannerly.com/demo)
![Scoping BIM Information Requirements using Level of Information Need](https://plannerly.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/Scoping-BIM-Information-Requirements-using-Level-of-Information-Need.png)
##  **Automated** [**BIM Checking**](https://plannerly.com/verify/)
### Save time and resources with integrated BIM scoping and model validation
![Automatic verification of Building Information Models \(BIM\)](https://plannerly.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/Automatic-verification-of-Building-Information-Models-BIM.png)
Getting compliant 3D models just got a whole lot easier!
Thanks to integrated information requirements and model-checking rules, your suppliers can **[instantly check their models for compliance](https://plannerly.com/verify/)** before sharing them with you for use.
With support for 80+ BIM file formats (yes, including Revit and IFC!), getting compliant 3D models has never been easier!
Plus, by linking up with [**Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)/Forma**](https://construction.autodesk.com/), versions are automatically synced and verified too!
No more tedious manual checks, hello stress-free compliance!
